jobs_results.title: Java developer (Gigabit hub) (w/m)
jobs_results.description:
We are Deutsche Telekom IT Spain, located in a digital, scientific, and cultural hub of Spain - Valencia.

We work as part of T-Systems Iberia though with a separate structure and projects. Our team is growing, and we are looking forward to meeting more talented employees from Spain and other countries. With our highly skilled engineers and experts, we are committed to continue developing the culture of creativity and agility, foster innovations, and be an international tech center!

We are looking for an experienced Java Developer to join an international agile scrum team in our Gigabit project- one of the biggest and most important projects in Deutsche Telekom Group. Your role will be to develop microservices based cloud solutions with Spring Boot framework. We expect that you will look for the most effective technical solutions for your product, building scalable services.

📒What tasks we have:

· New & further development of software for complex products and services with... strategic relevance, considering holistic business requirements

· Working closely together with your teammates and requirement engineers (Product Owner, Business Analyst, etc.) in analyzing and implementing requirements

· Working closely together with other international scrum teams in the development and implementation of web applications and REST services

· Creation of software & solution designs as well as their documentation

· Supporting colleagues in the form of code reviews and pair programming

· Encouraging the further development of the less experienced developers in the team

· Supporting the complete lifecycle management of the software and services for which you are responsible from development to test support to production support

Technology stack:

· Java 11 / Spring Boot

· AWS

· Sonar

· Maven

· Git (Gitlab)

· PostgreSQL

· Kubernetes, Docker

We expect from candidate:
• Several years of professional development experience in Java / Spring Boot/ Jakarta EE
• Very good knowledge of software design patterns and their practical application
• Good knowledge in Play2 Framework, REST, Mockito-Scala, WireMock, Keycloak / OpenID Connect / OAuth2.0 / Swagger
• Good knowledge in change and configuration management of CI/CD pipelines/DevOps
• Good knowledge of virtualization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes)
• Your test skills should cover: Gradle, Groovy, Postman/Newman/SoapUI
• Teamwork skills and agile mindset
• Hands-on experience in agile development methodologies and tools such as Scrum, Jira, Confluence
• Fluency in English

🤲What we offer:
• International, positive, dynamic, friendly, and motivated work environment.
• Modern office in the city centre.
• Flexible working schedule, fully remote or hybrid.
• Excellent opportunities for professional and personal development.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.

And many more advantages of being part of Deutsche Telekom IT!

Deutsche Telekom will only process the CVs of those who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: Programador/a / Desarrollador/a Junior Java / Python - Software ...
jobs_results.description:
En Telefónica Soluciones de Outsourcing buscamos a personas con formación y experiencia como Programador/a - Desarrollador/a junior Java/Python, software de ciberseguridad, si buscas desarrollarte en el mundo de la ciberseguridad te ofrecemos la posibilidad de incorporarte al equipo de Ciberseguridad, con aprendizaje y formación continua en nuevas tecnologías y apasionantes retos en un sector en constante transformación y actualización.

Rol
• Programador/a / Desarrollador/a Junior Java / Python - Software

Las Personas a Incorporar En El Puesto Deberán
• Llevar a cabo tareas de mantenimiento correctivo y evolutivo de herramientas internas y para clientes del Grupo Telefónica.
• Trabajar en equipo internamente, asì como con otros equipos integrados dentro de los mismos proyectos.
• Dar soporte a sus coordinadores y responsables de cara a facilitar la gestión interna del equipo, aportando información, experiencia y en aquellas circunstancias en las que se requiera.

Competencias... Técnicas o Conocimientos
• Al menos un (1) año de experiencia como desarrollador en proyectos de desarrollo y/o mantenimiento de software.
• Más de un (1) año de experiencia trabajando con las siguientes, metodologías tecnologías y herramientas.
• Nivel medio de Inglés, B2

Requeridas
• J2EE: Struts, Spring, Hibernate.
• Python y/o Perl y/o Bash.

Altamente Recomendadas
• ELK: Elasticsearch, Logstach, Kibana.
• HTML y CSS / CSS3.
• Operaciones con API REST.
• Procesamiento/composición de JSON.
• Subversion y/o GIT (acumulables).
• Despligues con ANSIBLE.

Valorables
• Metodologías ágiles (Scrum, Kanban).
• Desarrollo Seguro de aplicaciones.
• Pruebas funcionales y no-funcionales sobre aplicaciones.
• Configuración de entornos Windows y Linux.
• Tomcat y/o JBoss y/o Jetty (acumulables).
• JavaScript.
• C / C++.
• Node.js, AngularJS.

Condiciones Laborales
• Lugar de Trabajo: León, España. Imprescindible vivir en la misma provincia del centro.
• Tipo de Contrato: A Término Indefinido.
• Salario: A convenir de acuerdo a la experiencia.

Si cumples los requisitos no dudes en aplicar a la oferta, Telefónica Soluciones de Outsourcing busca profesionales como tu para proyectos siempre a la vanguardia de la tecnología

jobs_results.description: We are looking for versatile Software Engineers with solid foundations in our backend technologies (Java, Spring Boot, Oracle, Kafka, Docker, K8s). Relevant experience in frontend technologies (JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML5, CSS3 and SASS) will be a plus.Fleet Management Europe is a Webfleet Solutions line that combines our market presence across all European countries. You will be joining a team that will focus on creating new products and adaptations to address the most relevant industries in the target markets.Here's a little taste of your challenge:The successful candidate will become part of an agile cross-functional team of highly skilled and motivated engineers. Together with this team and in collaboration with other teams in our product engineering organization, you will:Discuss, define, and develop enhancement and adaptions of existing products and new products and services.Create solution designs for and deliver complete functionalities from backend to frontend.Work in a... technically complex and sensitive environment, requiring you to build relevant functional knowledge about the products and technical knowledge about the platform's stack and architecture.Keep a keen eye on application performance, operability, robustness, monitoring and failure resilience, data privacy, and the security of individual services and the whole system.Take holistic responsibility, including ongoing functional and performance improvements, bug fixing and issue solving on the production instances of your applications, test automation, and necessary configuration and data changes.Be involved in enabling and rolling out a solution to drive the business of large or enterprise partners and customers on various levels.Apply agile methods to organize your and your team's work, make your planning and team performance transparent, and manage your stakeholders.Who are you?You feel passion for software engineering, building products, tweaking systems, and have a "getting things done" attitude. Also, it will be of great help if you have as many as possible of the below:A degree in computer science, a related field, or equivalent experience.Great communication skills, holistic and systemic thinking, goal-orientation, quality-focus, versatile problem-solving skills, an open mind as well as at least 2 years of experience in commercial software development.Experience with JavaScript, React, Redux, HTML5, CSS3, REST APIsGood foundations of UX and graphic designFluency in English (written and spoken).Drive and mental flexibility to learn and interact with our backend stack (Java, Kafka, Oracle).Knowledge in Docker, K8s, and willingness to work in a DevOps culture is a plus!A desire to work as part of an international organization and cooperate with other software engineers, system engineers, architects, product owners and external partners across multiple locations.What can you expect?An adventure in software product development within a rapidly growing. A business unit of a globally renowned brand and various opportunities for your professional development.Being part of a team of expert developers and contributing in building and adapting technology for the Webfleet Solutions Service Platform.Brilliant minds. Learn from your colleagues – pioneers and experts who are changing the world.Different cultures. Our colleagues come from all over the world, with 55 nationalities and counting.Let's not forget the good stuff!Birthday off and volunteering time off.500 euros gross to set up your home office and additional monthly home office allowanceChance to work abroad for 40 working days per yearAdditional health and dental insurance.100% employer funded pension scheme.Lunch, childcare or transportation vouchers.Unlimited access to LinkedIn Learning.Access to Gofluent platform to learn new languages.Employee Assistance Program.Discount on Bridgestone tyres.Who are we?We areBridgestone Mobility Solutions,and we are on a mission to move the world towards a sustainable future using data-driven mobility.The high-value products and services we develop for fleets, original equipment manufacturers and governments make travel smoother, reduce congestion, increase accessibility, improve vehicle and road safety and cut carbon emissions.Bridgestone Mobility Solutions is a Business Unit of the Bridgestone Corporation, aglobal leader in tyres and rubber, present in Europe, the Americas, AustraliaandAfrica.Webfleetis one of our lines of business within Bridgestone Mobility Solutions. A globally trusted fleet management solution, Webfleet analyses live data fromhundreds of thousandsofvehiclestohelpbusinessesboostfleet productivity, cutcosts and increase safety.Webfleet is used by more than 50,000 customers worldwide, providing them with the industry's largest support network and the widest range of dedicated applications and integration tools.For further information, please visitwebfleet.com.Follow us on Twitter @WebfleetNews and ****** more information about Bridgestone in EMIA, please visitwww.bridgestone-emia.comandBridgestone newsroom.Want to join us?If that's a yes, then please apply to say hi. Complete the online form and attachments in English, please.Do note that online technical evaluation and pre-employment screening are part of the selection process.We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: Developer Java Junior (titulado/a universitario IT)
jobs_results.description:
En Getronics, queremos ampliar nuestro equipo incorporando a un/a Developer JAVA Junior en modalidad de trabajo híbrido (80 % teletrabajo y 20% presencial) para que forme parte de nuestro equipo trabajando en un proyecto dentro de administración pública ubicado en Valencia en horario flexible, principalmente de mañanas y a completar algunas tardes, además de jornada intensiva los viernes y meses de verano.

La persona que se incorpore nos ayudará en las funciones que implican desarrollos evolutivos, correctivos y adaptativos en los distintos sistemas de información.

REQUISITOS
• Titulación universitaria IT (se deberá acreditar)
• Experiencia mínima de un año trabajando en programación con las siguientes tecnologías: Java, J2EE, JSP, XML, XML schemas, servicios SOAP, JSON, servicios REST.

¿QUÉ OFRECEMOS?
• Podrás crearte tu propio plan de formación, seleccionando tus propios contenidos entre una plataforma propia con más de 15.000 opciones a tu alcance, entre las que encontrarás... contenidos acerca de las últimas tecnologías, metodologías ágiles, finanzas personales o salud mental, entre muchas otras opciones.
• Estabilidad, ya que formarás parte de una empresa con 130 años de historia y 4.000 empleados en 23 países, de los cuales, 1.800 están en España.
• Crecimiento profesional. Tendrás acceso a todas las vacantes de Getronics por si quieres dar un salto en tu carrera. Además, ponemos a tu disposición GetLead, un programa destinado a acompañar en el camino a nuestros futuros líderes.

jobs_results.title: Java Software Engineer experto en Cloud (AWS / Azure / GCP)
jobs_results.description:
¿Quieres formar parte de la experiencia Exceltic, una empresa con estrategia centrada en las personas?

📢 Si buscas formar parte de una gran variedad de proyectos punteros en una empresa tecnológica en fuerte expansión, queremos conocerte.

Desde Exceltic, buscamos un/una Java Software Developer para incorporarse a nuestro Centro de Excenlencia de Software y poder participar en proyectos de innovación de desarrollo de productos tecnológicos para el control de vertipuertos que estarán albergados en Cloud.

Funciones:
• Desarrollo de producto.
• Integraciones.
• Desarrollo de evolutivos, soporte y mantenimiento de producto.

Requisitos:
• Al menos 4 años de desarrollo software
• Backend developer (Java y Spring Boot)
• Amplios conocimientos Cloud (Amazon Web Services, Azure o Google Cloud Platform)
• Experiencia haciendo containers para Docker
• Conocimiento de arquitectura y patrones de diseño
• Valorable experiencia en campo logistica / aeroespacial
• Linux nivel administrador.
•... Soltura con BBDD. Ejemplo Postgres(sql) y valorable opensearch (nosql)
• Soltura con protocolos de red.
• Haber trabajado con metodologías ágiles.
• Experiencia en Python.
• Muchas ganas de innovar en el campo aeroespacial.

Vivir la experiencia Exceltic significa:

✅ Participar en proyectos punteros en donde puedas desarrollar tus habilidades.

✅ Percibir un salario competitivo en función de aportación.

✅ Disfrutar de un plan de retribución flexible.

✅ Equilibrar tu vida personal y profesional.

✅ Acceder a nuestro programa formativo personalizado.

✅ Cuidar de tu bienestar a través de: descuentos en el gimnasio con empresas colaboradoras, programa de bienestar con el empleado “feel good”…

✅ Formar parte de un equipo en el que te sientas escuchado/a y en donde puedas aportar nuevas ideas.

⭐ Pertenecer a nuestra Star Community.

👉 Acerca de nosotros…

Somos una empresa de servicios de ingeniería y consultoría tecnológica. Desarrollamos nuestra actividad en distintos sectores (Ferroviario, Aeronáutico, Espacio, Defensa, Energía, Automoción, Industria, Tecnologías de la Información y Telecomunicaciones). También proporcionamos servicios de auditoría técnica y formación especializada.

A día de hoy contamos con una sólida cartera de clientes multinacionales en los distintos sectores y una de las ofertas más completas del mercado.

En la familia Exceltic Somos más de 450 miembros y contamos con oficinas en Madrid, Barcelona y Bilbao y con proyectos en los cinco continentes.

¡Únete a nuestro equipo!

https://exceltic.com

jobs_results.title: Principal Software Engineer Java/Kotlin - Santander Auto Software
jobs_results.description:
Santander Auto Software is looking for a Principal Software Development Engineer

Santander Auto Software, a greenfield program where we are building a brand-new, state of the art global software platform and product suite that will be rolled out in 13 countries.

The business is 100% tech focused, comprised of skilled cross-border software builders, and with a leadership team made up of esteemed individuals with accomplished backgrounds in global tech players.

If you are looking for an opportunity to build creative technology solutions that positively impact hundreds of thousands of international customers, and relish large ownership and diverse technologies, join our team today!

Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of gender identity, culture and disability. Our mission is to contribute to help more people and business prosper.

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

We are looking for skilled back end focused software engineers with... experience working with Java (or Kotlin) and Spring Boot, Kubernetes and AWS, who have experience working in a software on demand production environment. You will build Cloud-native, AWS-based, greenfield software and will have time and support to invent solutions to a wide variety of user, business, and technical challenges. We have no cut-and-paste roles and neither will your software be of the cut-and-paste (or integrate and configure) variety. We operate a 'build it and own it' culture, and so you will have a DevOps and individual contributor mindset.

These will be key hires for back-end building squads and help shape this area of the business for scale and be a key member of a fast-growing global team!

EXPERIENCE
• Experience designing, building, scaling and maintaining large scale systems in a multi-tiered, distributed environment.
• Experience in driving high-impact complex problems.
• Exceptional coding skills and demonstrable experience implementing and elevating coding standards across teams.
• Experience with complex organizations with many stakeholders.
• Software development in Java (Spring Boot) or Kotlin - design, build, and deploy
• Production deployment experience working with AWS
• Experience with automated build and test systems for CI/CD (using Docker, Jenkins, etc)
• Experienced in true Agile and its engineering practices with a true DevOps mindset

EDUCATION
• Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or another related field. Or equivalent work experience.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE
• Back-end Development with Java or Kotlin.
• Fluent in English.
• Able to deal with ambiguity and change.
• Strong product ownership mindset.
• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal. Must be proficient in asynchronous communication.

LOCATIONS
• The vacancies will be fully remote based out of either the UK, Spain, Portugal or the Netherlands.

If you want to know more about us, follow us on https://www.linkedin.com/company/santander-consumer-finance-global-services/mycompany/

#LI-DNI

jobs_results.title: Java Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Our Client a large Government Tax Organisation is looking to grow it's already established Java Centre of Excellence team in Valencia (Spain) and is looking for local Spanish and English speaking Java consultants who are looking to work on Projects that are are exciting and using the latest technologies.

The objective is to build numerous Scrum Teams who will work on projects designed to improve the business processes to improve the speed at which Tax is collected (Personal Tax, Car Tax, Road Tax, VAT/GST, Customs and Excise...) as well as removing as much Human intervention to minimise the possibilities of Human Error.

This is an exciting time to join as there will be numerous opportunities to learn new skills as well as progress to more senior positions such as Development Team Lead, Solution Architect, Scrum Master.

The requirements for this role is that you are an experienced Java Developer with at least 3 years of Hands On experience, you are a fluent Spanish and English... speaker and you are able to work onsite in the Valencia office in a hybrid arrangement so you will be expected onsite between a few days a month and more regularly when there are deadlines approaching, Training or Workshops etc.

This is a great career defining opportunity that you will be able to learn, grow and progress to a very senior level.

As this is government sector it also comes with a very generous pension scheme.

Apply now for immediate interviews
